title: Liputan Sentrasoft menyebut “dosen”

images.alt: Judul dan paragraf pembuka artikel Sentrasoft tentang Abil Sudarman, kata dosen disorot
Paragraf artikel Sentrasoft yang menyebut Abil Sudarman AI engineer, dosen kecerdasan buatan, dan konten kreator
Bagian ASSAI pada artikel Sentrasoft yang menyebut Abil sebagai dosen AI di berbagai kampus
Infografik Perjalanan Karier Abil Sudarman: 290K+ pengikut Instagram, 8.3K+ pengikut LinkedIn, Dosen AI multi kampus

shows: Artikel Sentrasoft (28 April 2026, 5 menit baca) menyebut Abil Sudarman alias Abigail Aryaputra “AI engineer, dosen, dan founder ASSAI”, “sebagai dosen AI … pernah tampil di berbagai kampus, termasuk Universitas Dian Nusantara”, dan infografik karier (“Dosen AI — Multi Kampus”, 290K+ Instagram, 8.3K+ LinkedIn). Sorotan pada kata “dosen” dari penulis situs ini.
limits: Liputan mengulang klaim, tidak memverifikasinya; tidak menunjukkan penugasan mengajar resmi di kampus mana pun.

en.title: Sentrasoft coverage calling him a "lecturer"
alts: Headline and opening paragraph of a Sentrasoft article about Abil Sudarman, with the word "dosen" (lecturer) highlighted
Paragraph of the Sentrasoft article calling Abil Sudarman an AI engineer, AI lecturer and content creator
ASSAI section of the Sentrasoft article describing Abil as an AI lecturer at various campuses
Infographic "Abil Sudarman's Career Journey": 290K+ Instagram followers, 8.3K+ LinkedIn followers, AI Lecturer multi-campus
en.shows: A Sentrasoft article (28 April 2026, 5-minute read) calls Abil Sudarman, alias Abigail Aryaputra, an "AI engineer, lecturer, and founder of ASSAI", "as an AI lecturer … has appeared at various campuses, including Dian Nusantara University", and a career infographic ("AI Lecturer — Multi Campus", 290K+ Instagram, 8.3K+ LinkedIn). The highlighting of the word "dosen" (lecturer) is by the author of this site.
en.limits: The coverage repeats the claim and does not verify it; it does not show an official teaching assignment at any campus.
